name: rewind-cassette-player
description: Nostalgic 1980s/1990s illustrated cassette music player web application

scripts.build: python -c "import os, shutil; shutil.rmtree('dist', ignore_errors=True); os.makedirs('dist', exist_ok=True); [shutil.copytree(d, f'dist/{d}') for d in ['assets','css','js']]; shutil.copy('index.html', 'dist/index.html'); print('Production build complete in ./dist')"
